ViatProPage.hero_subtitle: The total comprehensive system connecting customs brokers, carriers, and exporters in real-time to streamline export processes with maximum cybersecurity.
ViatProPage.single_screen_desc: ViatPro displays the entire supply chain process on a single screen, resulting in a direct boost in operational efficiency and usability for logistics coordinators.
ViatProPage.edi_desc: Electronic data interchange for tracking and automated invoicing.
ViatProPage.profiles_desc: Tailored access control per user role and institution.
ViatProPage.flow_desc: Step-by-step process from initial document upload to customs clearance and dispatch.
ViatProPage.step1_desc: Exporters create and upload digital shipping documents into ViatPro.
ViatProPage.step2_desc: ViatPro automatically notifies Mexican and US customs brokers.
ViatProPage.step3_desc: Notifies the carrier team with shipment details and assigned route.
ViatProPage.step4_desc: Mexican customs broker audits documents and generates official customs declaration.
ViatProPage.step5_desc: US customs broker completes audit and processes US customs entry.
ViatProPage.step6_desc: Carrier completes e-manifest and downloads DODA / PITA for border crossing.
ViatProPage.track_desc: Full control over freight transport with predefined geofences and automatic security alerts.
ViatProPage.t1_desc: Custom notification settings for key transport milestones and events.
ViatProPage.t2_desc: Instant real-time updates with latest shipment details.
ViatProPage.t3_desc: Full GPS visibility and immediate detection of route deviations or infractions.
ViatProPage.t4_desc: Automated trajectory alerts upon any unauthorized route modification.
ViatProPage.ctpat_desc: We guarantee platform compliance with US Customs security standards for supply chain safety.
ViatProPage.wms_desc: Automated handling of receipts, dispatches, inspections, and yard trailers with timestamped alerts.
ViatProPage.w1_desc: Timestamped notifications from shipment arrival to final inspection.
ViatProPage.w2_desc: Visual reports and inspection photographs for swift cargo validation.
ViatProPage.w3_desc: Real-time visibility of yard trailer inventory with shipment timestamps.
ViatProPage.w4_desc: HTS classification directly integrated into WMS storage system.
ViatProPage.app_desc: Manage your customs and logistics operations right from your palm with our official mobile app.
ViatProPage.demo_desc: Our specialists are ready to show you live how to optimize export time and costs for your company.

CustomsAgencyPage.hero_subtitle: Management of import and export entries with strict regulatory compliance and swift clearance at major US and Mexico customs ports.
CustomsAgencyPage.sec1_desc: We have over 25 years of operational experience guaranteeing safe clearance and correct tariff classification for your cargo.
CustomsAgencyPage.s1_desc: Technical research in tariff classification and proper USMCA / T-MEC eligibility treatment to secure tax benefits.
CustomsAgencyPage.s2_desc: Accurate determination of tariff codes for new products and re-evaluation of import/export classifications.
CustomsAgencyPage.s3_desc: Continuous guidance on updates in laws, rules, and government agency regulations (SAT, ANAM, CBP).
CustomsAgencyPage.s4_desc: Specialized customs entry clearance across major ports of entry in overland, maritime, and air modes.
CustomsAgencyPage.s5_desc: Meticulous auditing of each shipment transaction to guarantee 100% regulatory compliance and prevent penalties.
CustomsAgencyPage.s6_desc: Real-time indicators processed from ViatPro to identify trends and discover genuine cost savings.
CustomsAgencyPage.op1_desc: Documentary and legal assistance to convert temporary customs regimes into definitive ones seamlessly.
CustomsAgencyPage.op2_desc: Temporary import of raw materials and components to Mexico under the IMMEX program with strict term control.
CustomsAgencyPage.op3_desc: Customs clearance formalities to verify and regularize legal stay of goods in the country.
CustomsAgencyPage.ports_desc: We hold direct customs licenses and coordinated infrastructure to expedite border crossing at major customs ports.

LogisticsPage.p2_desc: Immediate international bridge crossings coordinated to minimize customs wait times between Nuevo Laredo and Laredo, Texas.
LogisticsPage.p3_desc: Continuous tracking of every unit from origin to destination warehouse with real-time status updates.

LogisticsPage.s2_desc: Storage areas equipped with live surveillance cameras for maximum cargo protection.
LogisticsPage.s3_desc: Immediate access to customs entries, shipment status, bridge logs, and real-time GPS tracking.
